case_title: State (Government of NCT of Delhi) v. Nitin Gunwant Shah
trial_court_outcome: Convicted of murder and criminal conspiracy
neutral_facts: The victim, an employee of the accused, was involved in a dispute over payment. The accused hired another individual to eliminate the victim, who was shot dead. The prosecution relied on a complaint filed by the victim, which was later found to have discrepancies, including overwriting in police records and lack of corroboration. The accused were present in Delhi on the date of the incident, and their vehicles were linked to the crime, but no direct evidence of their involvement was established. The trial court convicted the accused based on the complaint, but the High Court acquitted them due to the failure to prove the authenticity of the complaint and the lack of corroborative evidence.
